card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on the comma after a date like 'January 1', and on isolated spots such as digits inside numbers, 'for' after 'Account', and 'top' after 'Back to'.

modes.label: Comma in a date
modes.description: The comma after a day and month at the start of a sentence, before the year.

modes.description: A digit partway through a year or dose number.
